messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "must use in setting where you can detect and respond to alarms to ensure full dose"
set: ["must use in setting where you can detect and respond to alarms to ensure full dose", "must use in setting where you can detect and respond to alarms", "caregiver must know where you keep it and how to use it", "not likely to miss dose in medical setting", "people can respond differently to the same medicine", "ensure 1 icon in dose window", "doctor may adjust dose depending on how well you respond to treatment", "doctor may occasionally change dose to ensure best results", "caregiver should know where naloxone is kept and how to use it", "use in child must be decided and monitored by specialist", "avoid these products to ensure effectiveness", "help must come from trained person to use pen", "healthcare provider will show you where to inject semaglutide", "keep your medicine in a place where no one can use it improperly", "prescriber will watch how you respond", "plan to stay somewhere you can relax and reach a bathroom"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
